Package chess.pieces

Enum Class PromotionPiece

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<PromotionPiece>
chess.pieces.PromotionPiece
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<PromotionPiece>, Constable
public enum PromotionPiece extends Enum<PromotionPiece>
The four pieces a pawn can be promoted to when it reaches the far rank.

Each value knows its display name and its notation letter. The piece itself is built by PieceFactory.
